mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS above 4.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 4% and PAYEMS shows a 3-month average increase of > 200k jobs, signaling a strong labor market, S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO, indicating improved industrial production, enhances productivity and thus S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during non-recessionary periods.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window during non-recession periods, or SPX returns are not significantly higher in growth periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in HOUST, signaling strengthened housing demand, positively influences S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, but only when RSAFS is above its 6-month moving average.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always, a low CPIAUCSL reading (< 240) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced inflation concerns.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or SPX returns are not significantly higher when CPIAUCSL is below 240 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When PAYEMS shows a 2-month consecutive decline, signaling labor market weakness, S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 20 trading days, especially during late-cycle periods.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when GDPC1 growth exceeds 3% annually and HOUST increases by > 10% month-over-month, S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 5 trading days, indicating robust economic demand.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.
